title: Optimal design with uncertainties: a risk-averse approach
summary: We study a class of stochastic optimal design problems for elliptic partial differential equations in divergence form, where the coefficients represent mixtures of two conducting materials. The objective is to minimize a generalized risk measure of the system response, incorporating uncertainty in the loading through probability distributions. We establish existence of relaxed optimal designs via homogenization theory and derive first-order stationarity conditions satisfied by the optima.
